entries.en: to withdraw oneself; to slip away and leave it (dejarlo ido)
entries.notes: 西语栏残损且标[疑]（dejarlo ydo nt aposble 难辨），据汉字“抽身”与对音 thû sîn / chiû sîn 定释义。

entries.en: to let oneself be carried along; to stroll at will (dejarse llevar)
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字标[疑:芽/步]；对音 pǒu 近“步”，据西语 dejarse llebar（任其而行）取“信步”。

entries.en: leave it at that for now; let it cease for the present (déjalo por ahora)
entries.notes: 对音 chià hôa / chŷ fê 与“即息”两字常规读音不合，四栏互证欠清晰；据汉字与西语 dejalo por agora 定为“暂且罢休”。

entries.zh: 搁放之处；放置东西的地方
entries.en: the place to set something aside; resting place for things
in front; before; in front of, in the presence of
beforehand; previously; first
entries.notes: 闽南语栏后半“toy suy”污损难辨（T99），据汉字“在先”与西语 Delante, primero 定释义。

entries.en: facing; in the presence of; opposite
opposite; facing; toward
at present; before one's eyes; currently
beforehand; previously; formerly
opposite; across from; the facing side

entries.zh: 前后；前后方（兼指时间先后）
entries.en: front and back; before and after
over there; on the other side or bank
entries.notes: 闽南语栏标[残]、标音尽污损（T99），据汉字“那邊”与西语 dela otra banda 定释义。

entries.en: over there; on that side
same; likewise (de la mesma manera)
sort, kind; in such a manner (as in 一般 “the same way”)
entries.notes: 闽南语栏标[残]，据汉字“般”与西语 Delamesma manera 定释义。

entries.en: together; all at once, at the same time
entries.notes: 官话对音首字标音污损（T99），据汉字“一齊”与西语 delamesma manera 定释义。

entries.en: like; as, resembling
in the same way; just so, likewise
entries.notes: 标音污损（T99）；末字“年”疑当作“然”（官话对音 niên 合于17世纪官话“然”的写音），据西语 delamesma manera 定为“同样”。

entries.en: in the same way; alike
entries.notes: 标音污损（T99），据汉字“一般樣”与西语 delamesma manera 定释义。

entries.zh: 譬亲像；正如、好比（譬如那样）
entries.en: just as; like, for example, in like manner
